phase_3_discoveries.statement: Silent overwrite failures become visible as explicit conflicts.
Forensic reconstruction shifts from ad-hoc logs to deterministic replay.
Delegation ambiguity is reduced by explicit authorization traceability.
Core TRS remains stable while domain policies vary independently above it.
Hard real-time and transport guarantees remain profile-layer, not new primitives.
